method: Manually read complete current diffs of the 10 named production files and five changed test files. Read surrounding update, rollback, old/candidate crash recovery, application activation/verification, configuration/execution recovery and retained-service restoration paths.
Fresh Python AST and SHA256 checks for every listed file; all match author report and actual final Linux fixture. Reviewer did not rerun tests or operate a server.
This is a focused independent integration review, not a whole repository audit. thread_history.py conversion body and its standalone test are separately reviewed by root and are not claimed here.
checks: The only added sudo permission is exact native-launch thread-history under the existing mode-specific fixed identity; no wildcard or arbitrary UID/home argument was added. Launcher admission verifies identity/security policy and selects its managed home before dispatch, and returns before provider-secret loading.

Installed capability threadHistoryRepair:1 and application codexHarnessThreadHistory:1 bind compatible selection. Candidate application activation is rejected before service stop when control lacks support; current new applications block old-control rollback and old recovery before selecting code.

Normal control update journals old/candidate exact sudo bytes plus execution identity, retains workspace/catalog permissions, writes candidate sudo before restarting, and restores original grammar on old rollback/recovery. Pre-existing journals without sudoPolicies retain their prior no-sudo-mutation interpretation.

Old execution/config-layer snapshots retain all other sudo flags while adding only the fixed helper when the currently selected control supports it. Recognition of historical exact grammars does not admit added/altered commands.

Ordinary Manager verification stays capability-aware; retained legacy sudo/worker verification still requires the bound restoring journal, private record, exact saved bytes/mode, current bindings and ownership.

Test changes retain existing hostile command and identity checks; added cases cover old helper grammar migration, interrupted recovery, unsupported control rollback, exact UID invocation without provider-secret reads, and real native/home restrictions.

linux.skipReason: Windows native rollout path prefix; all four root modules pass without skips.

limits: Actual Linux tests use isolated temporary filesystem fixtures; service operations are substituted. This review makes no new real systemd, sudo, production deployment, inference, external MCP or network claim.
The final Linux wrapper retains complete=false and exit3 because of one declared Windows-only skip; it is not rewritten as an all-platform/full-suite success.

A possible extra revalidation of a tampered yet exact-grammar candidate policy was considered, but no legal workflow mismatch was established. Root declined the extra hardening and the temporary code/test were reverted exactly. It is not an unresolved finding or release blocker.
package.json has a root-authored version/marker delta; its current hash is recorded separately and it is not claimed byte-identical to the isolated pack.
